name: recall_prompts
description: Search prompts they have written before. Use it when they refer back to an earlier request ('like the one I did for the auth service'), when you need the outcome of a previous prompt, or when you need to know how they normally phrase this kind of thing. Their old wording is a legitimate source of their words.

query.description: What to look for, in their terms.

returns.description: prompts[] each with prompt_id, title, submitted_at, status, an excerpt, and any recorded outcome.
